# RT-DETRv4 recipe reference

The checkout-only [DSI + GAM recipe](../../recipes/rtdetrv4/README.md) follows
[RT-DETRs/RT-DETRv4](https://github.com/RT-DETRs/RT-DETRv4) at commit
`55fefaaed7efe2a5f72d0a18fd4e05965e35c292`.

Source files, behavior changes, copyright attribution, license and validation
limits are recorded in the recipe's [NOTICE](../../recipes/rtdetrv4/NOTICE.md).
No official RT-DETRv4 detector or DINOv3 implementation/weights are vendored here.
